contract: acquisition(mu, sigma, f_best, cost) -> one score per candidate point; the loop stops when accumulated cost exceeds the budget (EvolCAF-style; cost(x) = 1 + mean normalized coordinate, a documented stand-in for the paper's cost functions). Score: mean simple regret
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
